                          How do I ask the nanny to start the rice
                          cooker at five, before we drive home?

Here is a polite, natural way to ask (请 = please).

In Chinese, you can say:

请你五点开电饭煲。我们开⻋回家。
Qǐng nǐ wǔ diǎn kāi diànfànbāo. Wǒmen kāichē huíjiā.

Key terms
  •  五点 (wǔ diǎn): five o'clock
  •  电饭煲 (diànfànbāo): rice cooker

Quick reference

English               Chinese           Note
Rice cooker           电饭煲            Common everywhere;
                                        also 电锅 in Taiwan
Five o'clock          五点              Also 五点钟

                            She said something like "gao ya guo" and
Sign in
                            pointed at the bo#le on the stove. What is it?

She most likely said ⾼压锅 (gāoyāguō), a pressure cooker.

To check you understood:

你是说⾼压锅吗？
Nǐ shì shuō gāoyāguō ma?
Gemini may display inaccurate info, including about people, so double-check its responses.

In Cantonese, people often just call it 煲 (bou1).


                         How do I tell the yuesao the soup is
                         too salty and she can add some water?

https://gemini.google.com/share/0a1b2c3d4e5f
                         too salty and she can add some water?
                         Simpli!ed please.

Simpli!ed version:

汤有点咸，加点⽔吧。
汤有点咸，加点⽔吧。
Tāng yǒudiǎn xián, jiā diǎn shuǐ ba.

Say it gently:
阿姨，汤有⼀点咸。下个⽉少放盐，她⺟亲也喜欢。

                                                Thanks! And how do I say "that's enough"?

Just say:

够了。

It works for food, water and toys.
